source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 我爱你中国！庆祝新中国成立77周年
topics.official_english: Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
topics.why_hot: National Day 2026 marks the 77th anniversary of the PRC's founding, and patriotic tributes dominate search traffic on October 1. Related holiday-celebration topics also trend in the same list.
topics.share_angle: Explain what National Day means in China today: the official ceremonies, how ordinary people mark the week-long holiday, and why patriotic content surges every October 1.

topics.official_english: Huawei Mate 90 Series Pricing Draws Attention
topics.why_hot: Pricing is the most-searched detail whenever Huawei launches a flagship lineup, and it feeds wider discussion of China's premium smartphone competition and consumer spending.
topics.share_angle: Walk viewers through why Huawei flagship pricing is treated as a national tech story — chip supply, brand positioning, and how it compares with rivals at home and abroad. Note that only the pricing topic is trending; confirm figures before quoting.

topics.chinese_topic: 年全国办理结婚登记676.5万对
topics.official_english: Nationwide Marriage Registrations Reported at 6.765 Million Couples
topics.why_hot: Marriage numbers are a closely watched social indicator tied to birth rates, housing demand and family policy. The trending headline omits the year, so the reporting period should be confirmed before citing.
topics.share_angle: Use the figure as a hook to explain China's marriage-rate debate: what drives the trend, how policy has responded, and why demographers watch it so closely.

topics.chinese_topic: 成都天府广场6.2万人观看升旗仪式
topics.official_english: 62,000 Attend Flag-Raising Ceremony at Chengdu Tianfu Square
topics.why_hot: Mass flag-raising ceremonies on National Day morning are a recurring holiday scene, and the Chengdu turnout gives the story a concrete, visual local angle.
topics.share_angle: Show how National Day is observed outside Beijing — city-level ceremonies, crowd turnout, and the travel patterns of the holiday week.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国选手0.002秒之差无缘冠军
topics.official_english: Chinese Athlete Misses Title by 0.002 Seconds
topics.why_hot: A margin of two thousandths of a second is a dramatic, shareable sports result and fits the National Day holiday mood of following Chinese athletes.
topics.share_angle: Use the near-miss to explain how timing is measured in the sport involved and what such razor-thin margins mean for athletes and rankings. The headline does not name the event or athlete, so verify before stating specifics.

topics.chinese_topic: 喝无醇啤酒开车不算酒驾？不实
topics.official_english: Claim That Non-Alcoholic Beer Does Not Count as Drunk Driving Is False
topics.why_hot: Fact-check topics spike during long holidays when drinking and driving rise, and this one corrects a common misconception about alcohol-free products.
topics.share_angle: Explain why low- or no-alcohol beer can still register on a breath test, and what Chinese traffic rules say about blood-alcohol limits. Stick to the debunk in the headline unless an authoritative source is cited.

topics.chinese_topic: 农民交公粮能否视同缴社保
topics.official_english: Should Farmers' Historical Grain Tax Payments Count as Social Security Contributions?
topics.why_hot: It touches rural pensions and intergenerational fairness, a long-running livelihood debate that resurfaces whenever social-security policy is discussed.
topics.share_angle: Lay out the question viewers keep asking — whether the abolished agricultural grain tax should be treated as pension contributions — and explain the current rural pension system framework. Avoid implying any policy change without an official announcement.

topics.chinese_topic: “比亚迪不是特斯拉对手”应验了吗
topics.official_english: Has the Claim That BYD Is No Match for Tesla Held Up?
topics.why_hot: Rivalry between China's largest EV maker and Tesla is a perennial debate, revived by sales figures and product news, so the topic rides on both tech and market interest.
topics.share_angle: Frame the comparison around publicly reported metrics — deliveries, revenue, market share, overseas expansion — and explain what such comparisons can and cannot show.
